requestBody.query: Will I get charged for Roam Better if I have a Travel Pass active?

200.answer: Travel Passes are compatible with Roam Better and take priority over Roam Better when travelling in an eligible destination. If you're using an active Travel Pass in an eligible destination, you won't be charged the Roam Better fee for the duration of your pass.
